policy.conditionOwnerIntent: Commercial condition pages own sell/buy/valuation intent for a device problem or physical condition.
policy.blogOwnerIntent: Blog pages own diagnosis, causes, repair guidance, troubleshooting and educational intent; they must not replace a stronger commercial condition owner.
policy.keepCurrentUrlRule: Historical owner-level GSC click or meaningful near-page-one signal; do not migrate during condition rebuild.
policy.migrateLaterRule: Core commercial condition with business value/content depth but insufficient stable owner-level GSC evidence for migration now.
policy.holdRule: No meaningful owner-level GSC evidence or not required in the initial condition authority surface; keep accessible but noindex.
policy.mergeRule: Intent substantially overlaps a stronger generic condition owner; keep noindex/canonical in staging until real HTTP redirect proof exists.
